snapshot.text: Fragmented, aid-dependent system in the West Bank and Gaza, where the Ministry of Health is one of four key providers. Severe financial crisis and medicine stockouts; war damage and displacement strain services. Over a third of essential medicines reached zero stock by June 2026.

priorities.title: Rationing scarce medicines and seeking donor funding
priorities.text: The ministry is stretching remaining stock toward urgent and essential care, while appealing to donors for life-saving medicines worth about USD 50 million for one year.

priorities.title: Winter health response for displaced Gaza residents
priorities.text: The minister urged a comprehensive humanitarian and health response to protect displaced people in flooded tents from respiratory infections and disease outbreaks.

netherlands.text: In 2025 the Netherlands earmarked €25 million for medical care in Gaza and neighbouring Egypt and Jordan, and continues to expand medical evacuation options.
